_om: Flinkisen in English (Swotty, rusj.no/en/swotty/) – the categories game: one letter, five or six categories, the first to finish says stop. Key = the Norwegian text in spill.js. Shared words come from rusj/kit/tekst.en.json.
«{pakke}» har litt drøyere humor og er b: ‘{pakke}’ has cheekier humour and is for adults only.
You said stop! The others have ten seconds.
{navn} said stop! Waiting for the last ones.
Én bokstav, fem eller seks kategorier, o: One letter, five or six categories, and everyone writes at once. Be the first to finish – but think of something nobody else has.
Mobilen trekker bokstaven og viser kateg: The phone draws the letter and shows the categories. Everyone writes one answer for each category – on paper, or on a phone each online.
Den første som har svar på alt, trykker: The first to have an answer for everything taps ‘Stop’. The others then have ten seconds.
Ta én kategori om gangen. Et svar ingen: Take one category at a time. An answer nobody else has scores 10 points. A shared answer scores 5. Blank or wrong scores 0. Most points after the last round wins.
Svaret må begynne på bokstaven. Skriv ba: The answer has to begin with the letter. Write just the word itself: ‘bear’, not ‘a bear’.
Uenige om et svar holder? Flertallet bes: Can't agree whether an answer is good enough? The majority decides.
På nett kan alle trykke «Teller ikke» på: Online, anyone can tap ‘Doesn't count’ on an answer. If most of the others say the same, the answer scores 0 points.
På nett går svarene gjennom rommet til d: Online, the answers go through the room to the other phones. The room is deleted a day after the last move at the latest.
På én mobil skriver dere på papir. Mobil: On one phone you write on paper. The phone only remembers the points.
Everyone needs a pen and paper.
Runden stopper når tida er ute – eller n: The round stops when time is up – or when someone says stop.
The round lasts until the first player says stop.
De tre siste bokstavene kan også trekkes: The last three letters can be drawn too.
Finn fram blyant og papir!: Get out a pen and paper!
Skriv tallene nedover arket. Den første: Write the numbers down the page. The first to have an answer for everything taps ‘Stop’ on the phone.
Samme regler: ett svar per kategori, og: Same rules: one answer per category, and the first to finish says stop.
Bokstaven er {b}. Kategoriene er: {kateg: The letter is {b}. The categories are: {kategorier}.
Sett 0, 5 eller 10 for den siste før der: Give the last one 0, 5 or 10 before you move on.
Sett 0, 5 eller 10 for alle før dere går: Give everyone 0, 5 or 10 before you move on.
Svarene går så snart mobilen er på nett: Your answers will go as soon as the phone is back online.
Answer not good enough? Tap ‘Doesn't count’. Most of the others decide.
Spill en runde, så blir det kåring!: Play a round and there'll be a winner!
Et tomt felt gir 0 poeng. De andre får t: A blank field scores 0 points. The others get ten seconds once you stop.
Ingen runde er ferdig ennå. Dere kan all: No round is finished yet. You can always start a new game.
Dere går rett til kåringen. Den som har: You go straight to the results. Whoever has the most points now wins.
